intentEvidence: I wrote this plugin so that I can easily take notes for my Algorithm and proof-based classes in Obsidian as well.
motivation: I wrote this plugin so that I can easily take notes for my Algorithm and proof-based classes in Obsidian as well.
problem: Obsidian's MathJax functionality does not allow for necessary LaTeX package imports (like algpseudocode) required for complex algorithm formatting.

relations.evidence: The idea of this plugin was heavily inspired by Quick LaTeX for Obsidian.

summary: A simple plugin that converts user input and keywords into standard LaTeX algorithm and pseudocode format within Obsidian.
